parsed.rationale: Regular narrow-complex rhythm with left axis deviation and very deep S waves in V1-V3 (S in V3 about 27 mm, plus R in aVL about 7 mm, which meets Cornell voltage). The concave, discordant ST elevation in V1-V3 is the expected secondary repolarization change of LVH, so it does not meet STEMI criteria.
